svg.aria-label: A pixel-art RPG opening starring Leo Reis, Senior Software Engineer from Brazil. Leo walks through a dawn landscape past a blossoming world tree, with Kumo the cloud floating alongside, stomping bugs and saving waypoints. A dialog box reads: Hi, I'm Leo, building frontends and product-facing systems, close to design and product. Lately: AI-assisted workflows, human-in-the-loop, tools, feedback loops, and a spec before the first line of code. I treat DX as seriously as UX, and I want interfaces that feel guided, like games, anime and cinematics.
